During the 2026 Iran War Islamist militants and extremists have carried out attacks in Europe. The acts have been described as Islamic terrorism or Jihadist terrorism. The attacks have been mostly done by Shia Islamists but some have been Sunni Islamists. Many have been in reaction to the 2026 Iran War. Many attacks have been done by groups funded by the Islamic Republic of Iran, and many have been done by Iran itself. The attacks have mainly been mainly targeting Jewish people, Cyprus, Azerbaijan, military bases, and US embassies
Timeline
March 1, 2026: Hezbollah struck the UK's RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus at around midnight, leading to a partial evacuation of the military faciality.
March 4, 2026: Greek F16s intercepted two Iranian drones headed towards Cyprus that were in Lebanese airspace. There was a temporary alert in Cyprus airspace after the attack then later canceled the warning.
March 5, 2026: Iran launched drone attacks against Azerbijan's Nakhchivan area. Four drones launched from Iran struck Azerbaijan hitting an airport and areas near a school in Shakarabad. At least 4 civilians were injured and infrastructure damaged. The president of Azerbijan Ilham Aliyev labeled the attack as a "terrorist act" and promised to use the "Iron Fist" to defend Azerbaijan against such actions. Azerbaijan summoned the Iranian ambassador and then threatened a military response, while moving to withdraw diplomatic staff.
March 6, 2026: Azerbaijani State Security announced on Friday it stopped Iranian intelligence agents from committing terror attacks against four targets. The four targets were the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline, the Israeli Embassy in Azerbaijan, a leader of the country's Mizrahi Jewish religious community, and the Ashkenazi synagogue. Other devices were discovered in the Garadagh district, including a remote-controlled bomb capable of affecting a 300-meter radius. A container near Shikhov in the Sabail District. “The series of planned terrorist and intelligence operations was orchestrated by Iran’s intelligence service SEPAH, assigning local operatives to conduct surveillance, acquire weapons, and secure transportation," the SSS said.
March 6, 2026: In London 4 men, one Iranian and three British-Iranians, were arrested for spying on Jews in London for Iran. 6 other men were arrested in the Harrow area on suspicion of trying to assist one of the men who was being arrested. The UK's prime minister Keir Starmer said “the police, the security services, and everyone involved in keeping Britain safe.” Also on a statement on social media he said: “People will be worried after today’s arrests, especially those in our Jewish community. Our world-leading security services will not hesitate to protect you.” Iran denied the attacks
March 8, 2026: In Oslo, Norway, three brothers, in there 20s, Norwegian citizens with Iraqi heritage,attempted to bomb the US embassy in Oslo. The brothers were arrested 3 days later in Oslo.
March 9, 2026: At around 4:00 AM a bomb detonated outside the synagogue of Liege. The attack was committed by Harakat Ansar Allah al-Awfiya also known as Ashab Al Yamin or IMCR.
March 10, 2026: In Cyprus a Hamas arms smuggler was arrested. The suspect procured 300 rounds of live ammunition. Investigations by Germany's Federal Prosecutor's Office suggested that the weapons were intended for coordinated attacks against Jews in Germany and across Europe.
March 11, 2026: The IMCR group claimed to have conducted an attack against Jews in Greece, but it has not been publicly verified.
March 13, 2026: A synagogue in Rotterdam, Netherlands was the target of an arson attack by IMCR.
March 14, 2026: A Jewish school in Amsterdam, Netherlands was bombed in a "deliberate attack against the Jewish community" according to the city mayor. "This is a cowardly act of aggression towards the Jewish community," the mayor said, also saying that Amsterdam "must be a place where Jews can live safely". Prime Minister Rob Jetten said "there must be no place for antisemitism" in the Netherlands. OnSaturday, the Israeli foreign ministry said that "in the Netherlands, an antisemitism epidemic is raging". The Israeli government also said "Where will the next attack be? The Dutch government needs to do much more to fight antisemitism." The attack was again done by IMCR.
